snippet.title: What the Bible Really Means by “Fruit”
snippet.description:
In this clip from our bonus episode of the Jubilee Church Podcast, Lead Pastor Bryan Mowrey and host Jordan Dillon unpack what Scripture means when it talks about “bearing fruit.” 

Bryan and Jordan discuss the biblical concept of “fruit,” how it reveals the true state of our relationship with Christ, and why fruit is less about religious performance and more about genuine transformation.

📺 Watch the full conversation here: https://youtu.be/hP4FG_Z3I3w
